requiredTier.description: Minimum entitlement tier required for this endpoint, when the denial came from a tier gate.

sourceName.description: Source name for the effective-rate estimate.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical source URL for the estimate/methodology.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 date when the source page was last updated, if known.

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

requiredTier.description: Minimum entitlement tier required for this endpoint.

GetBilateralTariffRequest.description:
Applied tariff on one HS6 product between two countries, from UNCTAD TRAINS
 via World Bank WITS. Excludes unilateral duties (Section 301/232, IEEPA,
 AD/CVD, safeguards).

partnerCountry.description: Exporter, 3-digit UN M49 ("484"). "000" returns MFN only.

reportingCountry.description: Importer, 3-digit UN M49 ("840"). EU members use the EU schedule.

year.description: Tariff year; 0 = latest year TRAINS lists for the importer.

GetBilateralTariffResponse.description: Applied tariff on one HS6 product between two countries.

filingReporter.description: Reporter code queried: "918" for EU members.

nomenclature.description: HS edition the importer filed in ("H5" = HS 2017).

unavailableReason.description: Why no rate was served. NOT_COVERED is final; UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE is a fault.

upstreamUnavailable.description: True on a fault, false on a coverage answer.

GetTariffTrendsRequest.description:
Request for tariff timeseries data.

 Without partner_country or product_sector, this serves the reporter's WTO MFN
 applied average over all products (indicator TP_A_0010), seeded on Railway; a
 reporter outside the seed is reported as uncovered, not fetched.

 With a partner other than World, or a product group other than all, it serves
 the reporter's effectively applied tariff (preferences included) on those
 goods, from World Bank WITS (UNCTAD TRAINS), fetched on demand and cached.
 Both are schedule rates: neither includes unilateral duties such as Section
 301 (see get-us-import-duty).

partnerCountry.description:
Exporting partner, 3-digit UN M49 code ("000" = World). Empty or "000"
 with no product_sector selects the MFN series.

productSector.description:
WITS product group: an HS section such as "84-85_MachElec" or "50-63_TextCloth",
 or "AgrRaw", "Chemical", "Food", "Fuels", "manuf", "OresMtls", "Textiles",
 "Transp" (case-insensitive). Empty or "all" means all products. Other values
 are answered NOT_COVERED.

reportingCountry.description:
WTO member code of reporting country, as a 3-digit UN M49 code
 (for example "840" = United States). Empty selects the "840" default.

years.description:
Number of years to look back from the newest seeded year, inclusive of
 both endpoints (years = 10 returns 11 calendar years). 0 selects the
 default of 10; the maximum is 30, which is the full seeded window.

coverageStartYear.description:
First and last calendar year covered by `datapoints`. Both are 0 when no
 datapoints are returned. This is the effective window after slicing to
 `years`, which may be narrower than the requested lookback when the seed
 starts later.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 time the data was fetched from WTO or WITS.

unavailableReason.description:
TariffTrendUnavailableReason says why no datapoints were returned. The
 distinction that matters is NOT_COVERED — a contract answer, nothing is
 broken and a retry cannot help — against every other member, which names a
 fault.

upstreamUnavailable.description:
True when datapoints could not be served because of a fault — a seeded
 reporter whose cache entry is gone, or a cache read that failed. False when
 datapoints are served AND when the request names a combination that is
 simply not part of seeded coverage, which is a contract answer rather than
 an outage.

GetTradeBarriersRequest.description: Request for SPS/TBT trade barrier notifications.

items.description:
WTO member codes to filter by. Empty = all.
 Accepted but currently ignored; no-op until this handler supports the parameter.

limit.description: Max results to return (server caps at 100).

measureType.description:
Filter by measure type: "SPS", "TBT", or empty for both.
 Accepted but currently ignored; no-op until this handler supports the parameter.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was fetched from WTO.

upstreamUnavailable.description: True if upstream fetch failed and results may be stale/empty.

GetTradeFlowsRequest.description:
Request for merchandise trade flow data, reporter versus World.

 Coverage is seed-backed: Railway pre-fetches a fixed set of
 reporter/partner pairs from WTO and this API serves slices of that history.
 It never calls WTO per request, so a well-formed combination outside the
 seeded set is reported as uncovered (see GetTradeFlowsResponse.
 unavailable_reason) rather than fetched on demand.

partnerCountry.description:
WTO member code of partner country, as a 3-digit UN M49 code.
 Empty selects "000" = World, which is the only partner currently covered:
 the WTO indicators behind these flows (ITS_MTV_AX, ITS_MTV_AM) publish a
 World total and answer 204 for every named partner. Any other code is
 accepted by validation and answered with unavailable_reason
 TRADE_FLOW_UNAVAILABLE_REASON_NOT_COVERED, so coverage can widen without a
 contract change.

reportingCountry.description:
WTO member code of reporting country, as a 3-digit UN M49 code
 (for example "840" = United States). Empty selects the "840" default.

years.description:
Number of years to look back from the newest seeded year, inclusive of
 both endpoints (years = 10 returns 11 calendar years). 0 selects the
 default of 10; the maximum is 30, which is the full seeded window.

coverageStartYear.description:
First and last calendar year covered by `flows`. Both are 0 when no flows
 are returned. This is the effective window after slicing to `years`, which
 may be narrower than the requested lookback when the seed starts later.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was fetched from WTO.

unavailableReason.description:
TradeFlowUnavailableReason says why no rows were returned. The distinction
 that matters is NOT_COVERED — a contract answer, nothing is broken and a
 retry cannot help — against every other member, which names a fault.

upstreamUnavailable.description:
True when flows could not be served because of a fault — a seeded pair
 whose cache entry is gone, or a cache read that failed. False when flows
 are served AND when the request names a combination that is simply not
 part of seeded coverage, which is a contract answer rather than an outage.

items.description:
WTO member codes to filter by. Empty = all.
 Accepted but currently ignored; no-op until this handler supports the parameter.

limit.description: Max results to return (server caps at 100).

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was fetched from WTO.

upstreamUnavailable.description: True if upstream fetch failed and results may be stale/empty.

htsRelease.description: HTS release of the chapter 99 index ("2026HTSRev21").

sourceUrl.description: HTS search page for the code.

unavailableReason.description: Why no line was served. NOT_COVERED is final; UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE is a fault.

upstreamUnavailable.description: True on a fault, false on a coverage answer.

groupName.description: WITS group name; empty when WITS has none.

importValueUsd.description: Merchandise import value in millions USD.

reportingCountry.description: WTO member code of reporting country.

productSector.description: Product sector or HS chapter description.
